name: 37225-topkdecode-gemma3-270m-1gpu
model: unsloth/gemma-3-270m-it -- Gemma 3 270M text decoder, bf16, one safetensors shard of ~0.54 GiB. The `unsloth/` mirror of `google/gemma-3-270m-it` (the Gemma Terms of Use apply); the two config.json agree.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup 20%, bounded at 4096 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. Seed static 37225.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain`, streaming, fixed shape: exactly 128 prompt tokens and exactly 512 output tokens (min == max on both) with `ignore_eos`, so the longest context reached is 640 tokens. Sampling is stochastic: temperature 1.0, top_k 50, top_p unset.
purpose: A compact text assistant streaming 512-token replies to short prompts for 512 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: unsloth/gemma-3-270m-it
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-model-len: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enforce-eager: false
